summary: ResetWorkflowExecution fails with 'workflow not found' when explicitly targeting an older run if the current execution record is missing, even though the targeted run exists.
userImpact: Users cannot reset workflows to older runs when the current execution has been deleted, preventing recovery from data corruption scenarios.
rootCause: The workflow loading logic checks the current_executions record even when an explicit runId is provided, causing it to fail when current execution is missing.
keyQuote: Reset always resolves the current execution first. When the `current_executions` record is missing, reset returns "workflow not found" regardless of the `runId` provided
